# 0x10000 like the old app0 - the otadata space freed up (0x2000) goes to
# nvs instead. Deliberately split so nothing changes at the end of the app
# area (0x310000): the FS partition keeps its previous offset and size.
# Anyone who has already uploaded a map doesn't need to re-run "uploadfs"
# after switching to this table - just reflash the firmware itself.
# The FS partition is named "spiffs" with subtype spiffs. Do not rename it:
# LittleFS.begin() mounts exactly this label by default
# "pio run -t uploadfs" looks for the last data partition with this subtype.
